description: This Java interface defines an authorization service for the Eclipse Hono framework. It provides methods to check if a user is authorized to perform specific activities or operations on resources, returning asynchronous Future<Boolean> results.

classes.name: AuthorizationService
classes.description: A service interface for authorizing access to Hono resources, providing methods to verify user permissions for activities and operations.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if a user is authorized to perform a specified activity on a resource, returning a Future that indicates success or failure.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if a user is authorized to execute a specified operation on a resource, returning a Future that indicates success or failure.
